scope: Presentation of three existing reviewed 2026 Pennsylvania county participation observations
input_tables: Each registered source's complete county-participation.csv, reconciled with its unchanged audit.json
normalization: Native ballots or ballots_cast divided by the same native county's registered_voters; no candidate votes or received-mail counts used as ballots
native_records: Every native participation field retained and compared against the complete source CSV; no filtering or sampling
native_printed_fractions: Separate from calculated fractions; missing native printed values remain null
counting_status: Unofficial; preserve native counting qualifications without interpreting reporting counters as finished counting
timestamps: Retain distinct source update literals and unestablished timezones; Centre index, PDF and API update tables remain separate
downloads: Existing immutable full participation CSVs and complete county packages; no parent file, release asset or download URL changed
production_status: Requires exact revision deployment and production verification
